lead.headline: EPA's database shows Nebraska with 24 of 66 plants nationwide holding an old, serious air violation never acted on
lead.number: 24 of 66 facilities (36%, 17-36% depending on the cutoff) with a high-priority violation from before July 2024, unresolved, no formal action ever; on Title V major sources alone, 5 of 40.
lead.watch_out: ADM Columbus isn't in the 24 and only 4 of the 7 named ethanol plants are; 19 of the 24 aren't Title V sources, and a records gap is likely (Nebraska's formal actions in the database fell 89% at the 2014 system switch).
